subject: Staggered deposit & invoice velocity — Net terms and VAT evidence for CardioTech
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@cardiotech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: paige.turner@cardiotech.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 17:14:00 +0000
Subject: Payment terms request for pilot (PO 7234)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. CardioTech is ready to sign the PO for the pilot (attached) but finance has asked if we can move to Net60 for the pilot period while we validate usage cadence. Also need clarity on VAT handling for cross-border invoicing — we are EU-based (IE) and will require either reverse-charge treatment or an invoice that shows our VAT number.

If Net60 isn't workable, can we explore a staged payment: 25% upfront, 50% on go-live, remaining 25% net60? Would appreciate a short amendment outlining the cadence so our AP team can process.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connell
Head of Procurement — CardioTech
attachments: CardioTech_PO_7234.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@cardiotech.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for pilot (PO 7234)

Hi Liam — thanks and congrats on moving to pilot. Quick read: PO received. We can be flexible but need to balance cashflow exposure. Two practical options from our side:

1) Staged deposit (preferred): 25% upfront, 50% on go-live (milestone invoice), 25% after 60 days from go-live. Redwood will issue invoices aligned to those milestones; we can accept Net60 on the final tranche.

2) Net45 across the board with a 10% early-pay discount if CardioTech pays within 15 days.

On VAT: we can apply reverse-charge if you provide a valid EU VAT registration number and a signed EU VAT declaration. If reverse-charge isn't applicable we'll charge VAT at the Irish rate but can supply the VAT-inclusive invoice.

I attached a short amendment draft (redwood_amendment_draft_v1.docx) showing option 1 — please review. If that looks OK, we can route for signatures and share a DocuSign link.

Quick ask: can AP confirm whether they require a single consolidated invoice per milestone or split invoices per feature deliverable? That affects invoice numbering on our side.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_amendment_draft_v1.docx

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Payment terms request for pilot (PO 7234)

Marissa — a couple internal notes before we lock the amendment: 

- Recommend adding a clause that ties the second tranche (50%) to an acceptance checklist to limit disputes. Keep milestone acceptance language tight ("SLA smoke tests pass OR agreed playbook executed").
- For EU VAT reverse-charge, require the customer VAT ID + a signed declaration; finance needs the VAT ID on PO and on invoices.
- If CardioTech insists on Net60 for all tranches, propose an interim credit holdback: 10% retained until final payment clears to protect cashflow.

I'll draft the acceptance wording if you want.

Cheers,
Naomi (Finance)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@cardiotech.com>, ap@cardiotech.com
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed amendment & milestone invoice plan — CardioTech PO 7234

Liam / CardioTech AP team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review, attached is a proposed amendment that implements the staged deposit approach with a short acceptance checklist and the following commercial terms (high level):

- 25% deposit due within 15 days of signed amendment
- 50% milestone invoice payable Net60 from the milestone invoice date (milestone = production go-live confirmed by acceptance checklist)
- Final 25% payable Net60 from final invoice date; Redwood retains 10% of the final tranche as a short-term holdback until the final payment clears if the customer requests Net60 across the board
- VAT: reverse-charge to be applied upon receipt of CardioTech VAT ID; otherwise standard Irish VAT applied

Please confirm:
- Preferred invoice split (single invoice per milestone vs. two line-items per milestone)
- CardioTech VAT ID and whether AP will accept reverse-charge

If this matches expectations we'll send the DocuSign link. Attachment: redwood_amendment_draft_v1.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
attachments: redwood_amendment_draft_v1.docx

From: accounts-payable <ap@cardiotech.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, liam.oconnell@cardiotech.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment & milestone invoice plan — CardioTech PO 7234

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — AP prefers a single invoice per milestone (one invoice for the 50% go-live tranche showing both line items and PO reference). We can accept reverse-charge; our VAT ID is IE3491827T. We will need the signed amendment and the DocuSign transaction id to attach to the payment batch.

Also confirm: do Redwood invoices include a separate VAT line and the buyer VAT number on the invoice? Our finance system requires the buyer VAT in the invoice metadata.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Senior AP Specialist — CardioTech
attachments: none

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: accounts-payable <ap@cardiotech.com>, liam.oconnell@cardiotech.com
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 16:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment & milestone invoice plan — CardioTech PO 7234

Marta / Liam — great, thanks for confirming the VAT ID and invoice preference. Two quick confirmations from Redwood: 

- We will issue one invoice per milestone that lists the two line items (services + success fee) and includes a separate VAT line. The invoice will embed CardioTech VAT ID (IE3491827T) in the metadata and on the PDF header.
- We've updated the amendment to add the acceptance checklist language and the retention clause; attached is a signed-amendment-stub while we route for final signature via DocuSign. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rdw/transaction/XYZ-12345

Next steps:
- CardioTech to countersign the amendment in DocuSign (we'll set 15-day turnaround for deposit)
- Redwood will issue deposit invoice once DocuSign completes

If you need different invoice formatting for your ERP please send a sample and we can adapt.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
